# apCassetteBeasts
An Archipelago implementation of the game Cassette Beasts.

notes.text:
### Download / Install instructions

Download the .apworld and .pck files.  The ap file will go in the custom_worlds folder in the Archipelago files.  The pck mod will go in your Cassette Beasts mod folder generally located in `C:\Users\(username)\AppData\Roaming\CassetteBeasts\mods` for windows and `~/.local/share/CassetteBeasts/mods/` for linux.  If that folder does not already exist you will need to create it.
NOTE: This mod requires cat's mod utils mod as well and will not work without it.  It can be found on the steam workshop, Mod Utils by cat or it can be downloaded from [the github releases](https://github.com/Yukitty/CassetteBeasts-modutils/releases) and put in the same folder above.

### Fixed
- Song parts and stamps skip location blocker and now check inventory before blocking
- Tutorial item hard replace script
- Damascus tape is now metal instead of astral
